title: Tackle
description: Deal damage equal to your PL + SL. If you damage the target, knock them Prone. However, if they reduce the damage to 0, nothing happens.

title: Grapple
description: Roll a contested Strength check against the target. If you win, the target is now Grappled.

title: Flurry of Blows
description: Roll Combat to Hit. Deal PLd6+PL on a hit.

title: Judo Throw
description: Roll a contested Strength check against the target. If you win, throw the target 10 + (PL*5)ft. The target takes 1d4 damage for every 10ft of distance thrown. If a target hits a wall or the floor directly, double the damage (before imbue).

title: Targeted Strike
description: Roll to Punch. If you hit, the target suffers the Stunned condition.

title: Headbutt
description: Roll a Combat roll to hit. If you hit, roll a contested Strength - Intelligence Level and deal 1d12 + PL. Whoever has the lower result suffers the Concussed condition.

title: Chokehold
description: Roll a contested Strength check against the target. If you win, the target is Grappled and takes PL*2 damage per round until they escape. Targets may roll Acrobatics to escape.

title: Manji Kick
description: Roll a Combat roll to hit. Deal PLd6+(PL*2) damage on a hit. Take 2d4 damage if you miss and your movement speed is halved until the end of your next turn.

title: Russian Hook
description: Roll a Combat roll at Disadvantage to hit. If you hit, deal PLd8+PL. This martial art may only be used once per combat.

title: Roundhouse
description: Roll a Combat roll at Disadvantage to hit. If you hit, deal TLd6+TL.

title: Jiu-Jutsu Hold
description: Roll a contested Technique check against the target. If you win, the target is Grappled.

title: Dropkick
description: Roll to Kick. If you hit, the target suffers the Stunned condition.

title: One-Inch Punch
description: Roll to Punch. This counts as a Sneak Attack.

title: Perfect Parry
description: Reaction. Roll a contested Technique and Speed check against the attacker. If you succeed, you negate all damage from the attack and may make a free Kick or Punch. However, if you fail, you take 1.5x the amount of damage from the attack.

title: Tatsumaki
description: Travel 20ft. in a straight line, dealing TLd6+TL to all adjacent targets in the path.
